case.question: Why is accurate geodetic control important for Artemis III data products?
case.gold_answer: Accurate geodetic control improves spatial data analysis and intercomparison, which is vital for mission planning and scientific analysis.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 1: artemis_geodetic_control | Geodetic control importance
retrieved.text: Accurate geodetic control directly affects the accuracy of spatial data analysis and intercomparison, which is vital to both mission planning and scientific analysis.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 2: artemis_science_objectives | Seven Artemis III science objectives
retrieved.text: The seven overarching Artemis III science objectives are understanding planetary processes, understanding the character and origin of lunar polar volatiles, interpreting the impact history of the Earth-Moon system, revealing the record of the ancient sun and astronomical environment, observing the universe and local space environment from a unique location, conducting experimental science in the lunar environment, and investigating and mitigating exploration risks.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 3: artemis_predeployment_assets | Pre-positioned science assets
retrieved.text: NASA should consider pre-positioning science assets near the Artemis III landing site, such as an inert cache of tools and instruments or instrumented landers or rovers for environmental monitoring.
